title: Dispute Determinations and Settlements — Good Faith & Price Estimates
content:
The outcome of a patient-provider dispute on Riverbend's charges under Good Faith & Price Estimates is recorded as one of four results.

| Outcome | What the patient owes | Adjustment on the hospital account |
|---|---|---|
| Patient favored: the dispute resolution entity determines an amount below Riverbend's billed charges | the determined amount, reduced further by the administrative fee where the type credits that fee when the determination is below the billed charges | the difference from the billed charges posts as a dispute determination adjustment |
| Provider favored: the entity upholds the billed charges | the billed charges | none |
| Settled: Riverbend and the patient agree before the determination | the settled amount; the fee credit does not apply | the difference from the billed charges posts as the adjustment |
| Dismissed as ineligible | nothing changes | none |

**In every outcome** the billing hold is released and the remaining balance resumes the statement cycle from where it stopped.

## Examples (hypothetical figures)

- Patient favored, on a type that credits the administrative fee: billed charges 5000.00, determined amount 4200.00, fee 25.00. The patient owes 4175.00.
- Settled at 4500.00 on billed charges of 5000.00: the patient owes 4500.00, with no fee credit; the difference from the billed charges posts as the adjustment.
- Dismissed as ineligible: the billed charges stand and no adjustment posts.
